name: lt.apibase/pirkimai
title: Lithuania Public Procurement
description: Active Lithuanian public tenders (EU TED + CVP IS) for AI agents: search by CPV, text, deadline.

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Searches open public procurement notices in Lithuania (EU TED + national CVP IS) by keywords, CPV code, region, estimated value and submission deadline. Each result has a link to the original notice. Ieško aktyvių Lietuvos viešųjų pirkimų.

text.description: Keywords in Lithuanian (or English for TED notices), e.g. "kelių remontas", "programinė įranga". All words must match; endings are ignored.

cpv.description: CPV codes or prefixes, comma-separated, e.g. "72" (all IT services), "45233000", "79340000,79341000". Use list_cpv to find codes.

region.description: NUTS 2021 county code: LT011 Vilniaus, LT021 Alytaus, LT022 Kauno, LT023 Klaipėdos, LT024 Marijampolės, LT025 Panevėžio, LT026 Šiaulių, LT027 Tauragės, LT028 Telšių, LT029 Utenos — or the county name, e.g. "Kauno".

min_value.description: Minimum estimated value, EUR (notices without value are excluded).

deadline_from.description: Submission deadline from (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: now (only open tenders).

buyer.description: Contracting authority name contains, e.g. "Kauno miesto savivaldybė".

source.description: Only one source: TED (EU, above thresholds) or CVP IS (Lithuanian national system).

sort.description: deadline (soonest first, default), published (newest first), value (largest first).

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: Returns one tender with full description, CPV codes and names, region, value, deadline and links to the original notice and PDF. id: e.g. "cvpis:10556371" or "ted:787554-2023".

tools.name: changes_since
tools.description: Returns tenders that were added, changed or closed after the given time (up to 30 days back), oldest change first. Use next_cursor from the response to continue. Optional cpv filter.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call (instead of since)

cpv.description: CPV codes or prefixes, comma-separated, e.g. "72" (all IT services), "45233000", "79340000,79341000". Use list_cpv to find codes.

tools.name: list_cpv
tools.description: Finds CPV codes by words (Lithuanian names from CVP IS, English for divisions) or by code prefix, with the number of active tenders for each code. Empty query lists the 45 top-level divisions. Free.
